column_descriptions.dataset: dataset key (green = Green et al. 2024; mathys2019 = Mathys et al. 2019; seaad_pfc = SEA-AD, Gabitto et al. 2024) (-)
column_descriptions.cell_type, gene_symbol, gene_id: cell type label, gene symbol as used by the dataset, Ensembl gene ID (-)
column_descriptions.gene_symbol_current: current NCBI symbol of the Ensembl ID (the gene page's name; the dataset symbol when NCBI gives no single symbol) (MyGene.info (fetch_gene_annotations.py))
column_descriptions.nucleus_tested: false if the gene was detected in < 10% of the nuclei of both groups (not tested) (nucleus-level test (Wilcoxon, step 11b))
column_descriptions.nucleus_significant: nucleus_padj < 0.05 (empty when not tested) (nucleus-level test (Wilcoxon, step 11b))
column_descriptions.nucleus_direction: higher in AD / lower in AD / unclear (log2 fold change and z-score disagree in sign) / not tested (nucleus-level test (Wilcoxon, step 11b))
column_descriptions.nucleus_padj: Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p-value over the tested genes of the cell type (nucleus-level test (Wilcoxon, step 11b))
column_descriptions.nucleus_log2fc: scanpy's log2 fold change: log2((expm1(mean_AD) + 1e-9) / (expm1(mean_control) + 1e-9)), means over nuclei of log1p-transformed normalized counts (nucleus-level test (Wilcoxon, step 11b))
column_descriptions.pct_ad, pct_control: share of the cell type's nuclei from AD (control) donors with at least one UMI count (nucleus-level test (Wilcoxon, step 11b))
column_descriptions.donor_test: significant (donor_padj < 0.05) / not significant / filtered (low counts, not tested at FDR) / not tested (removed by the pre-filter) (donor-level test (pseudobulk DESeq2, step 11))
column_descriptions.donor_padj: Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p-value with DESeq2 independent filtering (empty when filtered) (donor-level test (pseudobulk DESeq2, step 11))
column_descriptions.donor_log2fc, donor_lfcse: unshrunk log2 fold change, AD vs control, and its standard error (donor-level test (pseudobulk DESeq2, step 11))
column_descriptions.donor_log2fc_shrunk: apeglm-shrunk log2 fold change (used to pick drug targets when de_source is pseudobulk) (donor-level test (pseudobulk DESeq2, step 11))
column_descriptions.degas_log2fc, degas_padj: nuclei with high vs low DEGAS scores, split at the cell type's median score: log2 fold change (high vs low) and Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p-value over the cell type's genes (empty when not tested) (high vs low DEGAS score test (t-test, step 13b))
